_meta.purpose: Reference/demo content for the Fider ERP marketing and content team. Not live application data — pricing here is illustrative of the Moroccan car-rental market, not pulled from any agency's real fleet or the backend database.
_meta.priceNote: typicalDailyRateMAD and typicalDepositMAD ranges reflect commonly observed street/agency pricing for each tier in Morocco (Casablanca/Marrakech/Rabat/Tangier markets) as of 2026, gathered as general market knowledge, not scraped from a specific competitor. Agencies configure their own real rates in the product; nothing here constrains that.

categories.name: Economy
categories.description: Small, fuel-efficient city cars ideal for budget-conscious renters, short urban trips, and first-time visitors sticking to city driving. The highest-volume category in the Moroccan rental market.

categories.name: Compact
categories.description: A step up from Economy — slightly larger hatchbacks and sedans with more trunk space and comfort, popular with small families and longer intercity trips.

categories.name: Sedan / Mid-size
categories.description: Comfortable mid-size sedans favored for business travel, airport transfers, and renters who want more legroom and a quieter ride than compacts.

categories.name: SUV / Crossover
categories.description: Higher-riding vehicles with more ground clearance and cargo room — strong demand for trips outside major cities (Atlas mountains, desert routes, rural roads) and for renters wanting extra safety margin.

categories.name: Luxury / Premium
categories.description: High-end sedans and SUVs from premium marques, aimed at executive travel, weddings/events, and high-end tourism. Lower volume, higher margin, stricter eligibility (age, deposit, licence history).

categories.name: Van / Minibus
categories.description: Passenger vans and minibuses for group travel, family trips, and tour operators — seats 7 to 15+. Common for airport shuttle contracts and multi-day group tours.

categories.name: Pickup
categories.description: Light trucks used for rural/off-road travel, cargo hauling, and construction or agricultural business rentals. Popular in the south and for work-related bookings.

categories.name: Convertible / Sport
categories.description: Niche leisure category — convertibles and sport-trim coupes for special occasions, coastal drives, or renters wanting a distinctive experience. Very low fleet share, premium pricing.
